_description: Centralized error log for the Futuraria Design Harness. Every tool failure, API error, and unexpected result is recorded here — including those the user never reports. Used for continuous improvement.

_rules.mandatory_reporting: When ANY tool call fails, the Leader MUST log the full error context: tool name, arguments, error message, round, step index, provider, and timestamp.
_rules.user_visible: Errors are also sent to the user via chat as structured summary messages.
_rules.internal_only: This file is for internal analysis. Users see summaries in chat.
